title: Beyond the Visible: Benchmarking Occlusion Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the recall rate on the Occlusion Identification (OI) task to identify the models' tendency to default to 'safe' negative responses, and analyzing the error distribution (underestimation vs. overestimation) in the Occlusion Rate Estimation (ORE) task.
